notes.title: Bugfix Patch V1.0.84
notes.notes:
* Bugfix: Opening newbiekits would crash the server due to incorrectly named starter red dust which was added in previous update.
 * Autorun: Changed to run in direction you are looking while autorunning.

notes.title: Patch V1.0.83
notes.notes:
*Updated newbie kits. The food given for some of the kits was for a higher level so some food items were changed around.
 *Updated newbie kits: Added on white dust and red dust starter versions.
 *Updated newbie kit: Removed Fingle Recal and replaced with a starter version so it cant be abused.
 *Updated various item names that were 'starter' items such as from newbie kits. Renamed some from (S) to (N), such as Cornbread (S) is now Cornbread (N).
 *Updated newbie kits: Removed all totems since they are broken, plus can be abused (farming)
 *Updated newbie kit: Removed lvl 20 kits 'General Enhancers x5' to avoid it being abused (farming)
 *Bugfix Sprinting: Releasing shift key would not disable sprinting and you'd consume all your stamina.
 *Changed realms map loot odds of getting the rare drop from general creatures in that realm. Its now 5x higher. Still very low but definitely higher. This is for example the loot you roll for in spirit realm when you kill any random creature, it has a low chance to drop a viz ingot, viz enhancer, and soul totem.

notes.title: Small Update V1.0.82
notes.notes:
*Bugfix: tooltips show stamregenerror (all of them)
 *Bugfix: The new 'Shift' key activating autorun would also do so when you were chatting or attempting to split an item.
 *Re-added sprinting via'Shift' key.
 *Changed autorun to Alt+Shift.

notes.title: Update V1.0.8
notes.notes:
* Optimized adding items to existing stacks when looting items. The Loot-All was going slower with the addition of the new bags so this part of the system will now only check through inventory that is actually active slots and not all possible slots (1200).
* Optimized checking for an empty inventory space. It wont check all 1200 slots but rather only the active slots.
* Loot-All: Hotkey added 'Y' key to act as clicking the loot all button when a loot container is open.
* Debuff time: Max amount of time that can be added onto your target per hit with equipped dust has been changed from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.
* Debuff time: Minimum amount of time that can be added onto your target per hit is now 3 seconds. This allows even new players to experience the debuffs from dust equipped (staffs were already doing this 3 second minimum). Weather you have 1 debuff dust equipped or 300, you'll debuff for 3 seconds. Past 300 dust equipped and you'll get the increased time, such as 400 white dust will blind for 4 seconds. Normal mitigation rules still apply if you're fighting something far above your own level. This means 1000 dust = 10 seconds and 1k dust will be all you ever need equipped, however when you run into a higher level enemy, you would want additional dust to beat his mitigation.
* Weapons Crit Rate: Increased from 10% to 20%.
* Updated tooltips for 'stats' window (when you hover over a stat)
* Updated loot-all button to show 'Y' hotkey can be used.
* Updated the stats calculations for dust debuff times and calculated times to match the new way debuff time works from the changes up above.
* Some light tweaks to the sound system for clientsided sounds so they dont always require the server to tell the player to fire off the sound.
* Combat xp required calculation changed from Lvl x Lvl x 100, to Lvl x Lvl x 60. Combat level will now level up 40% faster.
* Tweaked some NPC logic so that an NPC can be owned and its inventory cant be accessed outside of the player owner. Currently used for the Demon Amulet so players cant go and steal your demon amulets from the container.
* Created the first public 'Dungeon Maze' which has been extended from the spider camp cave.
* Created the Possessed Monster UI window. Can toggle via 'P' key.
* Created the Demon Amulet spawnable item. Can be purchased from general merchants for 10,000 gold.
* Create the logic for Demon Amulets when spawned. Shortly after using/spawning a demon altar, all monsters in the area that are NOT Boss/Elite/Minion will be aggroed to the Demon Altar. The Altar will begin to bleed them dry for 10% of their health over 12 seconds. Each enemy that dies from the bleed attack will count towards the sacrifices amount. At the end of 12 seconds, the demon altar will self destroy and generate a possessed monster entry into your possessed monster list (P key). The demon altar can be right clicked and its inventory will open up. You may place items in there to offer up to the altar. Only the owner can access the altar. When the timer is up and as the altar self destroys, it will check the items in its inventory and add on bonus rare drops for items accepted by the altar. Any items that had no effect will be destroyed alongside the altar. The rare drops will be determined by the possessed monsters level. The additional rare drops will be determined by the sacrifices + any modifier items added into the inventory of the altar.
* Bugfix: Immunities logic was never working correctly. Elites that should have had 2 would sometimes end up with 1,2, or 3. Bosses that should have had 3 could also end up with 1,2, or 3.
* Added 2 random immunities to posse.
* Added immunity reading to the posse list so you know what immunities the posse will have prior to spawning them.
* Added the posse window to the saved windows list.
* Earthkeys Bugfixes: An earthkey instance was based on a players name which could be abused in 2 ways. 1-An alt could keep your instance alive forever so even if you died, you didnt lose the geo and could easily summon any portal to go back into your 'still alive' instance. 2-Another player could hop into your gate with you and go AFK, resulting in you no longer being able to run any new dungeons since the 1st instance still has not closed. Earthkey gates now use an added random number so the likeliehood of you hitting that random number twice in a row is slim to none. This means every gate will generate a new empty instance even if a player resides in your previous earthkey.
* Added 7 new dungeons, 1 for each town. These dungeons will act as a spawning area for random posse locations. In a future update, they will also be used to house a couple new elites and they will be used as town invasion triggers when monster population in the dungeons gets too high.
* Vagabonds, Elites, and Bosses now drop 2x their simple loot value in comparison to an equal level/stats monster.
* Bugfix: Stamina Regen wasnt showing up on tooltips.
* Bugfix: Newbie kit lvl 20 was giving 200x real lesser potions when it should have been giving the starter version.
* Bugfix: Dungoen Activator window and Tooltips were showing the incorrect 'Mob Amount' for earthkeys. The correct number of mobs was always being spawned.
* Added upgrade level text to bank slots.
* Shops now grab all the loot from you extra bags to showcase in the sell tab. Sell all simple loot will now account for the extra bags as well.
* Bugfix: Dragon realm orc champs were falling through map. Regenerated spawn points so they are above terrain.
* Sprinting has been removed and replaced with auto-run. Tapping 'Shift' key will enable autorun. Tapping W/A/S/D will disable autorun. While in autorun mode you can freely look around with camera without it influencing your direction. Using a glider while in autorun will change your autorun direction based on camera direction while gliding. In other words, you cant freely look around when gliding but can use it to easily change your direction of autorun. Glider logic would take a lot of digging into to get it to work in free look mode when in auto run so for now im not bothering.
* Added some spawners to all the dungeon area's.
* Added a spawner to the spider camp cave to fill in some extra spiders along the path to the camp.
* Added logic to place a posse into a random location thats realistic for that posses level, ie it wont place a lvl 10 posse in a level 140 dungeon cave.
* Disabled photo mode for now. Too buggy.
